name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
summary: In Deathknell's ruined chapel, Shadow Priest Sarvis guides the newly awakened Forsaken. He gives them purpose and directs them against mindless undead and local threats.

sections.title: Shepherd of the Newly Awakened
sections.body: Shadow Priest Sarvis guides Forsaken who have just risen from their graves in Deathknell. Their awakening can be jarring and horrific, and some lose their minds to frenzy or despair. Sarvis gives the newly risen a purpose. He sends them to put down the mindless corpses roaming the cemetery and secure Deathknell's borders against the Scourge.

sections.title: Securing Deathknell
sections.body: Shadow Priest Sarvis also directs Deathknell's defenses against threats in Tirisfal Glades. Scourge forces probe the town's perimeter, and Sarvis sends novices to gather vital intelligence and face trials of arms. The Forsaken must hold Deathknell against those forces.

faq.answer: Sarvis is a Forsaken shadow priest in Deathknell. He guides the newly awakened undead, gives them their first orders, and helps defend the town against the Scourge.

faq.q: Where can I find Shadow Priest Sarvis?
faq.answer: Shadow Priest Sarvis waits inside the ruined church at the center of Deathknell, in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why is Sarvis having players kill mindless zombies?
faq.answer: Some corpses raised from the grave lose their free will and sanity. The Forsaken see them as a danger to the settlement and destroy them before they can endanger the living dead.

angles.text: As an Undead, you hear Sarvis among the first voices after you wake from the grave. He sets you on the path to serve the Dark Lady.
As a Priest, you see Sarvis use shadow magic as a Forsaken mentor in a chapel stripped of the Holy Light.
